definitions.explanation: A line of people waiting for something, such as at a restaurant or event.
A formal line of people moving together, such as in a ceremony or festival.

{人気店|にんきてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{行列|ぎょうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ばない→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: You can't get into popular restaurants without waiting in line.
